title: turbo.json: the Service Worker generator is hashed into every ui package's build and type-check cache, though only the Console reads it
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y

Filing gate: ② should-fix from the director's `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record 6577669391 on PR #29326 (#29155), outside its hits face; class b · filed by `domain:ui#4` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** PR #29326 hashes `ui/packages/mobile/src/serviceWorkerSource.ts` into the generic `build`, `type-check` and `test` task inputs in root `turbo.json`. Only `@object-ui/console`'s build and type-check read that file, through its `vite.config.ts` and `tsconfig.node.json`. As written, an edit to the generator invalidates the build and type-check cache of every `@object-ui/*` package, so CI and local runs rebuild the whole ui tree for a change that affects one app.

**Location (after #29326 lands).** In root `turbo.json`, the `$TURBO_ROOT$/ui/packages/mobile/src/serviceWorkerSource.ts` entries in `tasks.build.inputs` and `tasks.type-check.inputs`.

**Wanted.**
1. Move those two inputs to the console's per-package tasks (`@object-ui/console#build` and `@object-ui/console#type-check`, or the console's own `turbo.json`), so other packages' caches stop moving on the generator.
2. Keep the generic `test` input. The root ui vitest config loads the console's `vite.config.ts`, so that input really is shared.
3. Keep `check:ci-filter-parity` and the `ui/scripts/` turbo-input suites green. The director's reading is that the `ci.yml` `core:` row stays. If moving the inputs changes what the parity gate requires, say so before you touch `ci.yml`, which is a governed path.

**Reader.** `domain:ui` (build tooling), size XS. It runs after PR #29326 lands.

**Dedupe.** Searched `serviceWorkerSource turbo inputs` and `per-package turbo input console`: no card.

Links back: #29155, PR #29326 (record 6577669391).
